{0|to select the bay where the fuel block will be loaded. Confirm the selected bay by checking the white arrow indicator on the panel.}

{0|the safety piston upward, ensuring that the safety zone is sealed and ready for fuel handling.}
{0|4.}{1|Open the Hatch:}{2|Use the}{3|Open Hatch}{4|command to unlock and}

{0|tablet and select the command to load a fuel block. The system will place the block into the safety zone of the selected bay.}
{0|6.}{1|Close the Hatch:}{2|Once the fuel block is loaded, use the}{3|Close}
{0|Hatch}{1|command to secure the bay. This step ensures that the compartment is sealed for safe operation.}
{0|7.}{1|Unisolate the Bay:}{2|Execute the}{3|Unisolate Bay}{4|command to lower}

{0|OPERATIONAL ASSISTANT}
{0|The Operational Assistant (AO) is prepared to always assist the operator of the nuclear plant. It is an autonomous unit of help and operational assistance:}
{0|Status report and warnings.}
{0|General maintenance analysis.}
{0|Maintenance and repair tasks.}
{0|Assistance in operational protocols.}
{0|Verification, adjustment, and control}
{0|of operating parameters (on demand).}

{0|AO can be controlled through the operating Tablet of the plant operator, and from this tablet it will be possible to know the location of AO, the battery level, the command it is executing and the active operational tasks.}
{0|To activate the working tablet, press the [TAB] key at any time.}
{0|About AO autonomy}

{0|The Operating Assistant uses a rechargeable battery to be able to move freely through the plant. Although the battery is long-lasting, and has between 8 and 10 hours of autonomy, it will require resting in the charging bay to recharge. During the reload time, AO will not respond to any commands.}
{0|Status report and warnings}

{0|During plant operation, situations may arise that will require the immediate attention of the Plant Operator. If this were the case, AO will automatically intervene to warn or suggest the best plan of action.}
{0|General maintenance analysis}

{0|One of the main tasks of AO is the analysis of the situation of the plant. By starting the "Preventive Maintenance Analysis" command, AO will walk through the entire plant and analyze each component. At the end, it will prepare the maintenance report, with the details of each element analyzed. The maintenance report is the main tool of the Plant Operator to plan maintenance and repair tasks.}
{0|Maintenance and repair tasks}

{0|Daily maintenance tasks are crucial for safe operation. Based on the maintenance report generated by AO, the Plant Operator will be able to plan and order maintenance tasks. When initiating the "Start Maintenance Tasks" command, AO will perform the necessary tasks on each selected item.}
{0|Assistance in operational protocols}
{0|If necessary, the Plant Operator may request assistance to receive help or carry out the main protocols of plant operation:}
{0|Help with Active Alarms}
{0|Reactor start-up protocol}
{0|Stabilization Protocol}
{0|Verification, adjustment, and control of operating parameters}

{0|Although AO does not have permission to take full control of the reactor, it can verify and control some subsystems, such as the Pressurizer or stabilization through Control Rods. Operational skills are not an initial part of AO and must be acquired separately through Prestige Points.}

{0|The Operating Assistant can execute up to two or more operating tasks simultaneously, but if he receives another type of command from the Plant Operator, all operational control tasks will be suspended and will once again be the responsibility of the Plant Operator.}

{0|CORE FUSION SEQUENCE}

{0|Countdown Initiation}
{0|When the core fusion is triggered, a countdown timer is displayed, indicating the time remaining until the fusion process concludes.}
{0|Decision Point}
{0|As the countdown progresses, players must decide between two options:}
{0|1.}{1|Attempt to Halt Fusion:}{2|Choosing this option involves engaging in a}
{0|challenging mini-game or series of tasks to reverse the fusion process. Success results in a prestige point reward and a bonus for all repairs conducted during the fusion event.}
{0|2.}{1|Escape via Train:}{2|Opting to escape via the train initiates a new game}
{0|with 50% of the player's points, experience, and level. This choice allows for a fresh start but with reduced progress.}

{0|If the player chooses to attempt to halt the fusion, they will face a mini-game that challenges their skills. Successful completion of the mini-game results in a reversal of the fusion process.}
{0|To successfully complete the mini game during the core fission sequence, players must achieve at least two out of the following three achievements:}
{0|1.}{1|Manual Control Rod Insertion:}{2|Successfully introducing all control}
{0|rods manually using the operational crane, with a minimum number of control rods remaining undamaged.}

{0|Players must manually operate the crane to introduce all control rods into the core. The challenge lies in ensuring precision and minimizing damage to the control rods during the insertion process.}
{0|2.}{1|Fuel Block Extraction and Storage:}{2|Accomplishing the extraction of}
{0|the fuel block and securely storing it in a final disposal capsule.}
{0|3.}{1|Actual Fuel Temperature Reduction:}{2|Successfully reducing the}
{0|actual temperature of the fuel during the fission sequence.}

{0|Meeting the requirements of at least two out of the three achievements demonstrates the player's proficiency in managing critical aspects of the core fission sequence. It ensures a successful outcome in the mini-game, contributing to the prevention of catastrophic consequences.}
{0|Points and Prestige Reward}
{0|Successfully reversing the fusion not only prevents catastrophic consequences but also rewards the player with prestige points and a bonus for all repairs conducted during the fusion event.}
